title: feat(api)!: rename the user response field
body:
## Rationale
API consumers confuse the existing name field with a login identifier; the response needs a distinct label for the person's full name.

## Testing
Validation has not been performed; test selection is pending.

## Limitations
Compatibility details and migration guidance will follow separately.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/api.md b/docs/api.md
--- a/docs/api.md
+++ b/docs/api.md
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 # User response
 
-Example: {"name": "Ada"}
+Example: {"full_name": "Ada"}
